# Ranking Fixer

> Ranking Fixer (rankingfixer.com) is a technical SEO consultancy run by Calebe Araujo, a full-stack developer and tech lead based in Sorocaba, Brazil, working remotely with businesses and agencies in the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada and New Zealand. It finds the technical problems that keep websites from ranking on Google and implements the fixes in the code, the theme or the CMS. Contact: calebe.development@gmail.com.

Background: building websites since 2015, first as a freelancer; today a full-stack developer and tech lead specialized in CMS integrations across multiple websites (headless CMS and APIs) and in web performance optimization. Ranking Fixer does not guarantee rankings, buy links or sell content packages.

## Services

- [Home](https://rankingfixer.com/): overview of the technical SEO services and how the work runs.
- [Technical SEO audit](https://rankingfixer.com/technical-seo-audit): crawling, indexing, rendering, speed and structured data, ranked by impact, with fixes implemented.
- [Core Web Vitals optimization](https://rankingfixer.com/core-web-vitals-fix): LCP, INP and CLS fixed at the source.
- [Google indexing fixes](https://rankingfixer.com/google-indexing-issues): Search Console page indexing errors.
- [SEO website migration](https://rankingfixer.com/seo-website-migration): redesigns, replatforming, domain changes and traffic drop recovery.

## Who it is for

- [White label technical SEO for agencies](https://rankingfixer.com/white-label-technical-seo)
- [Technical SEO for law firms](https://rankingfixer.com/technical-seo-for-law-firms)
- [Ecommerce technical SEO](https://rankingfixer.com/ecommerce-technical-seo)

## Countries

- [Technical SEO in the UK](https://rankingfixer.com/technical-seo-uk): cookie consent banners and Core Web Vitals, UK and Ireland versions, VAT in product data, SRA requirements for solicitors.
- [Technical SEO in Canada](https://rankingfixer.com/technical-seo-canada): bilingual English and French sites, Bill 96 for stores selling to Quebec, Canada and US targeting.
- [Technical SEO in New Zealand](https://rankingfixer.com/technical-seo-new-zealand): sites serving New Zealand and Australia, .co.nz domains, remote work across the time difference.

All countries are served remotely; Ranking Fixer has no local offices.

## Guides

- [All technical SEO guides](https://rankingfixer.com/guides)
- [Why is my website not showing up on Google?](https://rankingfixer.com/guides/website-not-showing-on-google)
- [Website disappeared from Google? Causes and fixes](https://rankingfixer.com/guides/website-disappeared-from-google): for sites that used to rank; noindex, robots.txt, removals, manual actions, hacks and server problems, in order.
- [Crawled - currently not indexed: how to fix it](https://rankingfixer.com/guides/crawled-currently-not-indexed)
- [Discovered - currently not indexed: how to fix it](https://rankingfixer.com/guides/discovered-currently-not-indexed): Google knows the URL but has not crawled it; crawl waste, internal links and server speed.
- [Duplicate without user-selected canonical: how to fix it](https://rankingfixer.com/guides/duplicate-without-user-selected-canonical): the three canonical statuses compared and how to make Google keep the right URL.
- [Soft 404 errors in Search Console: how to fix them](https://rankingfixer.com/guides/soft-404): pages that return 200 but look missing, with fixes for SvelteKit, Next.js and Angular.
- [Sitemap could not be read (couldn't fetch): how to fix it](https://rankingfixer.com/guides/sitemap-could-not-be-read): sitemap statuses, how to test the file and the causes Google lists.
- [Core Web Vitals assessment failed: how to fix it](https://rankingfixer.com/guides/core-web-vitals-assessment-failed)
